instruction: Look at thread_plate.step in NX CAM. Drill and thread mill the six M8 pilot holes in thread_plate.step. Thread Milling must reach Z=0.000 mm and include arcs or a helical approximation. Tool definitions: T1 is a 6.8 mm drill for M8 pilot holes; T2 is an M8 thread mill. Write the required output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-18.nc. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
